flicker_strike_count.reading: averageBurstHits = 1 + 16 = 17: 2 extra strikes x 8 removable charges. Removable is 8 with 7 forced charges, so one extra consumable charge comes from the build's modifiers (CalcPerform Multiplier:ExtraConsumablePowerCharges); the source modifier was not identified.

method_reading: The community figure is burst damage per Flicker Strike use at forced charges, with charges forced above the maximum (7 > 6). TotalDPS is AverageDamage x Speed and ignores charge generation time.
